title: Alleppey Canal Weekend
text: We swapped a longer drive for an early canoe in Kuttanad. That gave us a morning on the small canals and time for a proper lunch back by the water.

title: Munnar Estate Trails
text: The best part was the first hour, before the mist lifted. Staying two nights gave us time for a walk before the day visitors arrived.

title: Fort Kochi After the Tide
text: The town made sense once we got out of the car and followed the waterfront. The evening performance gave us a reason to stay in town.

title: Tea Hills & Backwaters
text: One full day in the hills and a night on the water was the right combination for us. We were glad we checked the houseboat boarding time first.

title: The Classic Kerala Circuit
text: The kids wanted more time at the spice garden. We moved lunch back and shortened the afternoon drive, which made the day better for everyone.

title: Cliffs of the Malabar Coast
text: We spent most evenings between the clifftop and Odayam. Checking surf conditions early helped us decide which plans to keep.

title: Wayanad Coffee Trails
text: An estate walk after the long drive was exactly our speed. We went to Edakkal the next morning when everyone was rested.

title: Bekal & the Northern Shore
text: Bekal deserved a night of its own. The fort was cooler later in the day and the open coastal views were the highlight.
